{"code": "
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, PatternFill, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

# 建立 workbook 和工作表
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "銷售報表"

# 欄位標題
headers = ["月份", "營收", "成本", "利潤"]
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
header_alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

# 寫入標題列
for col, header in enumerate(headers, 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.alignment = header_alignment
    cell.border = thin_border

# 範例資料（12個月）
sample_data = [
    ("1月", 150000, 90000, 60000),
    ("2月", 180000, 100000, 80000),
    ("3月", 210000, 120000, 90000),
    ("4月", 195000, 115000, 80000),
    ("5月", 230000, 130000, 100000),
    ("6月", 250000, 140000, 110000),
    ("7月", 280000, 160000, 120000),
    ("8月", 270000, 155000, 115000),
    ("9月", 290000, 165000, 125000),
    ("10月", 310000, 175000, 135000),
    ("11月", 340000, 190000, 150000),
    ("12月", 380000, 210000, 170000),
]

# 寫入資料
for row_idx, (month, revenue, cost, profit) in enumerate(sample_data, 2):
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=1, value=month).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=2, value=revenue).number_format = '#,##0'
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=3, value=cost).number_format = '#,##0'
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=4, value=profit).number_format = '#,##0'
    for col in range(1, 5):
        ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col).border = thin_border

# 調整欄寬
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 10
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 15

# 儲存檔案
wb.save("/tmp/sales.xlsx")
print("✅ Excel 檔案已建立: /tmp/sales.xlsx")
print(f"   工作表名稱: 銷售報表")
print(f"   欄位: 月份, 營收, 成本, 利潤")
print(f"   資料列數: {len(sample_data)} 列")
"}
